answer: Duplicate identities collide like echoes in a canyon, forcing attackers to burn repeated stake and compute per fake node. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, recorded in the shared atlas of registered peers. A reputation ridge built from peer attestations raises the cost further, since fresh sybils start with zero trust and must earn it slowly. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
